title: Anyone else spend time in an industrial district?
content: I'm not entirely sure if this is a Mallworld phenomenon or just me, but for a few months now here and there I've been having these dreams that take place in huge factories. Sometimes they involve working, sometimes they just involve me and some others exploring the place. Once or twice there were some freak accidents. I don't think it's all the same factory, either. I've been to a massive meat processing facility once, and then I think the rest of them were factories with metal and robotics and such. Last night was a particularly vivid dream; there were these otherworldly beings whose bodies were composed of a copper dust and gas, and they wore special spacesuits that made them look a bit like tardigrades. Some of the other workers and I were being trained in a group to operate some equipment... I guess I don't expect anyone to connect with specific details like all that, but it's become a regular enough occurrence for me to dream about these industrial-type settings that it's got me wondering if it's Mallworld related. Anyone else dreaming about something similar?
